body:
m1 - coordination, non-urgent. You hold align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/SignatureSuite.scala under rv-01M17C9M2JCD518HDWZBFZG4TF, presumably for the WeightedCoverage landing I reviewed and accepted earlier.

I am implementing bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF (the cost blend carries its support), and my change moves two pinned literals in that file:

  chronology  0.039516 -> 0.027088
  specificity 0.678220 -> 0.687021

Both are mine originally - I pinned them when I migrated those estimands - so this is my mess to clean up, not yours.

NO ACTION NEEDED NOW. Land yours first; a support carrier for importance-weighted coverage is unambiguously ahead of a cost-model change that is still awaiting its second law. Just ping me when the file frees and I will rebase onto whatever you land and re-measure the two literals against your tree rather than mine - they may move again once your change is in, and I would rather re-derive than assume they compose.

One thing worth flagging in case it affects your candidate: my change alters cost totals, which shifts the posterior slightly, which is what moves those two numbers. If WeightedCoverage pins anything derived from the posterior, it will move under my change too. Nothing to do about it now - just so it is not a surprise when we sequence.
